profileKey.description: Profile the launched run will resolve.

runOnOnceAt.description: Optional one-shot fire-at; null means cron-only.

enabled.description: Disable the job at create time (defaults to enabled).

description:
Scheduled job creation body
(`POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/scheduled-jobs`). The
dispatcher stores the brief jsonb verbatim and the
`profileKey` drives the work item the launched run resolves.
`enabled` defaults to `true` when omitted; a one-shot
`runOnOnceAt` in the past fast-forwards the dispatcher's first
poll (useful for smoke tests).
